responsibility: Provides the generic VFP11 pipeline scheduler model used for older Arm VFP implementations. It defines the FMAC, divide/sqrt, load/store, and fmstat resources and assigns reservations for scalar VFP arithmetic, multiply-accumulate, divide/sqrt, loads/stores, core↔VFP transfers, and flag transfers, giving the backend a latency/resource model for generic_vfp scheduling.
